ex.en: This bread has a soft texture and a slightly sweet taste.
ex.zh: 这种面包质地柔软，味道微甜。

words.note: texture 指质地、手感；常与 smooth、rough 搭配。

ex.en: She hung her coat in the closet and went into the kitchen.
ex.zh: 她把外套挂在衣橱里，然后走进厨房。

words.note: closet 是美式壁橱；作形容词可指秘密的，如 closet fan。

ex.en: Reporters continued to speculate about the reason for his sudden exit.
ex.zh: 记者们继续猜测他突然离职的原因。

words.note: speculate about 表推测；speculate in 表做投机。

ex.en: Workers began to dismantle the old stage after the concert.
ex.zh: 音乐会结束后，工人们开始拆除旧舞台。

words.note: dis-（去除）+ mantle（覆盖物），指拆卸、拆除。

ex.en: The film tells the story of a monster living deep in the lake.
ex.zh: 这部电影讲的是一个生活在深湖中的怪物的故事。

words.note: monster 作形容词可指巨大的，如 a monster truck。

ex.en: The trees are in bud, and the garden looks alive again.
ex.zh: 树木正在抽芽，花园又显得生机勃勃。

words.note: in bud 指含苞待放；nip sth in the bud 指防患未然。

ex.en: Please confirm your booking by email at least two days in advance.
ex.zh: 请至少提前两天通过邮件确认您的预订。

words.note: confirm 指证实或确认；名词 confirmation。

ex.en: Engineers spent the whole night fixing a bug in the system.
ex.zh: 工程师们花了一整夜修复系统里的一个漏洞。

words.note: 可指电脑漏洞或小毛病；作动词还有烦扰之意。

ex.en: Her prescient warning about the risks turned out to be right.
ex.zh: 她关于风险的有先见之明的警告后来被证明是对的。

words.note: pre-（预先）+ sci（知道），与 science 同源。

ex.en: New staff are given a week to acquaint themselves with the office.
ex.zh: 新员工有一周时间熟悉办公室的情况。

words.note: acquaint sb with sth 表使了解，常用于被动。

ex.en: The waistband is elastic, so the trousers fit almost anyone.
ex.zh: 裤腰是松紧的，所以这条裤子几乎适合任何人。

words.note: elastic 指有弹性的，也可喻灵活的；名词 elasticity。

ex.en: Heavy rain and the consequent flooding closed several roads.
ex.zh: 大雨以及随之而来的洪水使几条道路封闭。

words.note: consequent 后常接名词；consequently 意为因此。

ex.en: The vast majority of students supported the new library plan.
ex.zh: 绝大多数学生支持新建图书馆的计划。

words.note: the vast majority of 是高频搭配；vast 强调数量巨大。

ex.en: The teacher had to intervene when the two boys started shouting.
ex.zh: 两个男孩开始大喊时，老师不得不介入。

words.note: intervene in 指干预某事；intervene between 指居中调解。

ex.en: The dove is often used as a symbol of peace.
ex.zh: 鸽子常被用作和平的象征。

words.note: a symbol of 表象征；symbolize 意为象征，是动词。

ex.en: A single spark can ignite the dry grass in seconds.
ex.zh: 一颗火星就能在几秒内点燃干草。

words.note: ignite 指点燃，也可指引发争论；名词 ignition。

ex.en: The film was a commercial success but critics disliked it.
ex.zh: 这部电影在商业上很成功，但评论家不喜欢它。

words.note: 作形容词指商业的；名词 commercial 指电视广告。

ex.en: The report contained a shocking revelation about the company's finances.
ex.zh: 这份报告包含了一个关于该公司财务的惊人内幕。

words.note: revelation 指揭露的真相；动词 reveal 表示揭示。

ex.en: Tickets are still available at the box office until Friday.
ex.zh: 周五之前售票处仍有票出售。

words.note: 可作定语或表语；be available to sb 表某人可用。

ex.en: Innumerable stars appeared once the clouds had cleared.
ex.zh: 云散之后，无数星星显现出来。

words.note: in-（不）+ numer（数）+ able，指数不清。

ex.en: She has long advocated stricter rules on food safety.
ex.zh: 她长期以来主张对食品安全实行更严格的规定。

words.note: advocate 后接 doing 或 that 从句，不接 to do。

phr.zh: 把 A 限制在 B

ex.en: The illness confined him to bed for almost a week.
ex.zh: 这场病使他卧床近一周。

words.note: confine A to B 把 A 限制在 B；be confined to 表局限。

ex.en: He travelled the world in quest of rare birds.
ex.zh: 他走遍世界寻找稀有鸟类。

words.note: in quest of 相当于 in search of；也作 quest for。

ex.en: The frequency of online meetings has risen sharply this year.
ex.zh: 今年线上会议的频率急剧上升。

words.note: frequency 是 frequent 的名词；常与 high、low 连用。

ex.en: The question failed to elicit any response from the audience.
ex.zh: 这个问题没能引起听众的任何回应。

words.note: elicit 指诱出、引出；与 illicit（违法的）易混。

ex.en: The team was relegated to the second division last season.
ex.zh: 这支球队上赛季被降到了乙级。

words.note: relegate A to B 指把 A 降到 B，也指使降级。

ex.en: Don't waste time arguing about such trivial matters.
ex.zh: 不要把时间浪费在争论这种琐事上。

words.note: tri-（三）+ via（路），原指路口闲谈，故为琐碎。

ex.en: The village held a simple burial for the old fisherman.
ex.zh: 村里为这位老渔夫举行了简朴的葬礼。

words.note: bury 是动词，burial 是名词，指埋葬或葬礼。

ex.en: You can take only one piece of hand luggage on board.
ex.zh: 你只能携带一件手提行李登机。

words.note: 不可数名词，用 a piece of luggage；美式用 baggage。

ex.en: The main drawback of the flat is its lack of parking space.
ex.zh: 这套公寓的主要缺点是缺少停车位。

words.note: drawback 指不利条件，近义于 disadvantage。
